args.script:
cat > calc_size.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
total=0
for f in sample_directory/*; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    size=$(stat -c%s "$f")
    total=$((total + size))
  fi
done
echo "$total"
EOF
chmod +x calc_size.sh
./calc_size.sh
